snapshot.cross_check: $1.2550 last trade on Kraken, 3:26 AM MDT (Kraken 24h range $1.1969 to $1.3169)

confirmed: XRP is about $1.26 early Friday, down about 2.9% over 24 hours, about 2.9% lower than 7 days ago and about 16% below 30 days ago (CoinGecko snapshot, 3:26 AM MDT; Kraken last trade $1.2550, 24h range $1.1969 to $1.3169). Crypto sold off Thursday evening after Binance disclosed a major hack; CoinDesk reported XRP down as much as 7.4% at the lows, with bitcoin briefly under $77,000.

Binance hack: Binance said Oct 29 that a security incident had an estimated impact of about $6.3 billion, with about $3 billion frozen on-chain, and that it will cover all losses from its SAFU emergency fund and company funds (Binance announcement, CNBC, BBC). TRM Labs attributes it to North Korea's TraderTraitor group and says funds moved across ten blockchains including the XRP Ledger. Deposits have resumed; Binance expects withdrawals back within about 48 hours. Binance.US says it was not affected.

US data Oct 29: Q3 GDP grew at a 3.4% annual pace (forecast 3.2%); September PCE inflation was 3.6% year over year and core PCE 3.1%, both in line with forecasts but up from August. The Fed held rates at 3.75% to 4.00% on Oct 28 in a 10 to 2 vote with two members wanting a hike, and markets still lean toward a December hike (CoinDesk, Cointelegraph). Coinbase reported Q3 revenue of $1.20B to $1.22B, slightly below estimates, with adjusted EBITDA above estimates (CNBC, CoinDesk).

Ripple and Coinbase announced today that RLUSD can now be traded and held in the Coinbase app, Coinbase Exchange and Coinbase Prime, with 1:1 conversion from dollars, and deposits and withdrawals on the XRP Ledger, Base and Ethereum (Ripple, Oct 28). This is about the RLUSD stablecoin, not an XRP listing change.

Moody's rated RLUSD A2 long-term and P-1 short-term on Oct 27, citing reserves mostly in short-term US government assets and cash held at BNY, with a 103% coverage target; it also flagged that holders don't yet have a direct claim on reserves (Moody's, Decrypt, The Block). Ripple separately said it is on track for about a $900M annual product revenue run rate (Ripple, Oct 28), and Garlinghouse said on stage, 'We will never give up on XRP' (U.Today).

BNY now supports XRP and RLUSD custody: Ripple and BNY announced Oct 27 that BNY's Digital Asset Custody platform now supports XRP and RLUSD for institutional clients. Plans to let BNY clients mint and redeem RLUSD directly, and a tokenized trade finance pilot with C2FO on the XRP Ledger, are still subject to approvals. Reported independently by The Block and Cointelegraph.

C2FO and Ripple will bring settlement for C2FO's new Instant Pay product onto the XRP Ledger, using RLUSD, so suppliers paid early get funds in seconds instead of days (Ripple, Oct 27). Settlement is in RLUSD, not XRP.

Ripple and Robinhood partnership: RLUSD is live on Robinhood Chain and Bitstamp by Robinhood and is expected in the Robinhood app later in 2026, with no launch date or eligible states announced yet; Robinhood plans institutional settlement in RLUSD on the XRP Ledger, also with no start date (Ripple, Cointelegraph, CryptoSlate Oct 28).

Ripple's national trust bank got final OCC approval (announced Oct 26). It will manage RLUSD reserves and offer business custody; it cannot take deposits or make loans. Treasury Secretary Bessent appeared with Garlinghouse at Swell on Oct 27 and spoke about stablecoins and dollar strength broadly, not XRP specifically.

US spot XRP ETFs took in about $8.43M on Oct 29, led by Franklin's XRPZ ($5.57M) and Bitwise ($2.86M), after flat days on Oct 27 and 28; cumulative net inflows are about $1.81B and total net assets about $1.47B (SoSoValue via ChainCatcher).

Swell wrapped up Oct 29 in New York. Garlinghouse said Ripple will prioritize XRP 'any place it makes sense' while also using RLUSD and fiat, and set a five-year ambition for XRP to become a standard for institutional payment rails; he gave no price target (TokenPost, FXStreet citing Bloomberg). Separately, XRP Ledger developers proposed a fixCleanup3_5_0 upgrade tightening rules for 'restricted' tokens; it is not active on mainnet (CoinDesk).

Ripple's regular monthly escrow release of up to 1 billion XRP is scheduled for Nov 1 (6 PM MDT Oct 31). This is routine, not new. An XRP Ledger bug fix (fixCleanup3_4_0) is expected to activate about Nov 4 if validator support holds.
not_confirmed: The CLARITY Act has not passed the Senate: the 'Senate Banking Committee advances CLARITY Act 15 to 9' posts recycle a May 14, 2026 vote, and the full Senate then failed to advance it 49 to 50 on Sept 15. 'Trump signs crypto bill' posts are false. 'Whales now control nearly 74% of supply' does not match the latest Santiment figure of about 68.5% for 10M+ XRP wallets. The '3.7 million XRPL transactions in a day' figure is real but is from Oct 25, after an unusually low Oct 24, so it is not new. BlackRock's appearance at Swell is a digital-assets director on an asset-manager panel, not a BlackRock XRP deal; no BlackRock XRP ETF filing or BlackRock–Ripple deal exists. No outlet confirms the '$60 billion in XRP transfers overnight' or 'Trump met with Ripple' posts. Ripple is not releasing 1.3 billion XRP on Nov 1. 'Binance XRP open interest CRASHED 28%' posts describe a real CryptoQuant figure, but it is a decline over five weeks (since Sept 22), partly because XRP's price fell, not a sudden crash today. 'XRP holders will get paid just for being active on X, starting next week' names no developer and no program and matches engagement-bait patterns. 'Ripple moved 220 million XRP' posts describe on-chain transfers between Ripple-labelled wallets with no stated purpose; internal moves are common before the Nov 1 escrow release and are not a sale. '17 of the biggest banks are live on SWIFT's ledger' is a Great Reset-style claim with no XRP link shown. 'XRP hit $37,000 on Bybit' posts have no evidence; XRP trades near $1.26 on every major venue. 'XRP holder accumulation jumped from 1M to 190M XRP in two weeks' gives no source or wallet definition. 'The Fed is being told to stand down as XRP gets the green light' has no basis. Price 'what if' posts are speculation with no source. 'Reset is live' countdowns, 'QFS card' help desks, airdrops and move-your-coins or message-me-for-a-guide offers fit common scam patterns. Details are in the rumors section.

news.headline: Binance's $6.3 billion hack: What we know and what comes next
news.summary: TRM Labs links the attack with high confidence to North Korea's TraderTraitor group. A Fundstrat strategist says it does not currently appear to pose a significant solvency risk for Binance; the key tell is how quickly withdrawals resume.

news.headline: Binance says its $6.3bn hack involved more than a compromised laptop
news.summary: Citing TRM Labs: most funds left Binance wallets in about 20 minutes across ten chains, including the XRP Ledger. Deposits are operating normally; withdrawals are on track to resume after a security revamp.

news.headline: XRP Ledger developers tighten the rules for who can hold 'restricted' tokens
news.summary: Four proposed changes bundled as fixCleanup3_5_0 would close loopholes in issuer approval for regulated tokens such as stablecoins and tokenized funds. None is active on mainnet yet.

news.headline: XRP drops 6% despite Ripple's projected $900M annualized revenue
news.summary: Garlinghouse told Bloomberg XRP is 'at the heart of everything Ripple does' and remains a bridge asset; XRP was testing support near $1.24. Technical levels are analysis, not a forecast.

news.headline: Security Incident Update
news.summary: Binance estimates the incident's impact at about $6.3B, says about $3B is frozen on-chain, found no evidence of a private key leak, suspended deposits and withdrawals as a precaution, and will cover all losses from SAFU and company funds.

news.headline: Crypto giant Binance hit by hack suspected to be largest in history
news.summary: About half of the $6.3B was frozen; the hack eclipses the $1.5B Bybit theft of 2025. Co-CEO Richard Teng says it was a complex attack, not one engineer's permissions.

news.headline: Live updates: Binance confirms security breach, cryptos fall
news.summary: Running coverage of Oct 29: Q3 GDP 3.4%, core PCE 3.1% in line, Coinbase Q3 results, then a late selloff with XRP down 7.4% at the lows as the Binance news spread.

news.headline: Coinbase (COIN) earnings Q3 2026
news.summary: Revenue of $1.20B trailed estimates; adjusted net income of $719M was lifted by gains in Coinbase's crypto investment portfolio.

news.headline: Ripple CEO Sets Five-Year Goal for XRP as Schwartz Sees Retail Blockchain Use
news.summary: Garlinghouse at Swell: Ripple will prioritize XRP where it fits a transaction and use RLUSD or fiat elsewhere. No price target or XRP share of volume was given.

news.headline: Bitcoin dips below $80,000 as Samsung-led tech jitters and a hawkish Fed weigh on crypto
news.summary: Bitcoin fell from above $81,700 to about $79,800 in Asian trading after Samsung shares dropped more than 5% on a chip-unit miss; XRP, ETH and SOL fell with it. About $356M of futures were liquidated in 24 hours, $205M of it longs.

news.headline: Ripple is heading for its best year ever while XRP faces its worst since 2022
news.summary: Contrasts Ripple's approaching $900M revenue run rate and 1,700+ institutional customers with XRP's roughly 29% loss in 2026 (CryptoRank), raising the question of when XRPL adoption shows up as token demand.

news.headline: Ripple and Stellar outlook: XRP and XLM lose ground as hawkish Fed tone weighs
news.summary: XRP is testing support near $1.30 after the Fed hold, below its 50, 100 and 200-day moving averages. Technical analysis only, not a forecast.

news.headline: Ripple CEO Addresses the One Rumor XRP Holders Kept Asking About
news.summary: Second outlet confirming Garlinghouse's Swell remarks: 'We will never give up on XRP,' with RLUSD described as complementary rather than a rival.

news.headline: Fed leaves interest rates unchanged, as expected
news.summary: The Fed held its range at 3.75% to 4.00%. Bitcoin edged up to about $81,000 and the 10-year Treasury yield rose about 4 bp to 5.025%.

news.headline: Bitcoin shrugs off a hawkish Fed as volatility bets barely budge
news.summary: 10 to 2 vote with Cook and Hammack dissenting for a hike; Warsh offered no dovish signal. December hike odds rose to about 82.6% (CME FedWatch); bitcoin options volatility was essentially unchanged.

news.headline: Ripple and Coinbase Partner to Expand Access to Ripple USD
news.summary: RLUSD is live on Coinbase Prime, Coinbase Exchange and the Coinbase app with 1:1 dollar conversion; deposits and withdrawals on XRPL, Base and Ethereum. International exchange support, including use as collateral, comes later.

news.headline: Ripple reports banner year approaching $900M annual product revenue run rate
news.summary: Ripple's own Swell kickoff release: on track to exit 2026 at about $900M annualized product revenue, with 1,700+ institutional customers. Company-reported figures, not audited.

news.headline: Moody's assigns investment-grade ratings to Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin
news.summary: A2 long-term and P-1 short-term deposit ratings for RLUSD issued by Ripple's Standard Custody & Trust Co.; reserves mostly T-bills and cash at BNY with a 103% coverage target.

news.headline: Moody's rates Ripple's $2.6B RLUSD stablecoin A2, a day after OCC bank approval
news.summary: Notes Moody's caveats: the issuer is not bankruptcy-remote and holders lack a direct ownership interest in reserves today; the GENIUS Act taking effect in 2027 would address that. The rating was requested by the issuer.

news.headline: 'We Will Never Give Up on XRP': Ripple CEO Ends Speculations
news.summary: At the Swell main stage, Garlinghouse pushed back on claims Ripple is abandoning XRP for RLUSD, calling the two complementary.

news.headline: XRP Open Interest Falls 28% on Binance to $445 Million by Oct. 27
news.summary: CryptoQuant's Darkfost: Binance XRP futures open interest fell 28% since Sept 22, below its 180-day average, partly from the lower price and liquidations. Analysts call it deleveraging; past-pattern rebound talk is not a forecast.

news.headline: Robinhood links 29 million app users to Ripple's XRP Ledger
news.summary: Careful read of the Robinhood deal: RLUSD in the Robinhood app is expected later in 2026 with no date or eligible jurisdictions announced, and planned XRP Ledger settlement has no start date. The '29 million users' headline is Robinhood's user base, not users of XRPL today.

claims.claim: 🚨JUST IN: An $XRP Ledger developer reveals that XRP holders will GET PAID simply for being active on X, WITHOUT having to hold XRP anymore, starting NEXT WEEK!
claims.who: Community account on X, Oct 30 (copied by many accounts)
claims.check: No developer, project or program is named, and no outlet reports it. 'Get paid for being active' offers are a common engagement-bait and scam pattern; never connect a wallet or share keys for one.

claims.claim: JUST IN: Nearly 220 million XRP moved across two large transactions on the XRP Ledger. Ripple-labelled accounts.
claims.check: An on-chain transfer report between Ripple-labelled wallets; no outlet has confirmed it or a purpose. Moves between Ripple's own wallets are routine around the monthly escrow release (Nov 1) and are not a sale.

claims.claim: 🚨 JUST IN: Ripple XRP OVERNIGHT... 17 Of The BIGGEST Banks Are Already Live On SWIFT's Ledger! XRP Holders, Watch This (GREAT RESET 2026)
claims.check: No source is given and no outlet ties SWIFT's ledger work to XRP. 'Great Reset' framing is a common hype pattern.

claims.claim: JUST IN: Bitwise and Franklin ETF clients buy a combined $8.43 million worth of $XRP.
claims.check: Matches SoSoValue's Oct 29 data: $8.43M net inflow to US spot XRP ETFs, led by Franklin XRPZ and Bitwise. Corroborated.
claims.check_title: ChainCatcher: SoSoValue XRP ETF data, Oct 29

claims.claim: 🚨🚨 BREAKING?! DID XRP JUST HIT $37,000 ON BYBIT?! 👀🔥
claims.check: No evidence of any such print. XRP traded near $1.29 on CoinGecko and Kraken at refresh time. Even a display glitch on one exchange would not be a real price.

claims.claim: 🚨BREAKING: The Federal Reserve is being told to STAND DOWN as $XRP gets the GREEN LIGHT as the U.S. dollar alternative! Crypto CLARITY Act is 'going to pass' any day now
claims.check: The Fed just held rates on Oct 28 with two members wanting a hike; nothing tells it to 'stand down' for XRP. The CLARITY Act failed to advance in the full Senate 49 to 50 on Sept 15 and no new vote is scheduled.
claims.check_title: Roll Call: Senate Banking approves crypto market structure bill (May 2026)

claims.claim: 🚨BREAKING: $XRP holder accumulation skyrockets from just 1 MILLION to nearly 190 MILLION $XRP in TWO WEEKS.
claims.check: No source, wallet group or data provider is named, and no outlet reports it. Treat as unverified.

claims.claim: 🚨 BREAKING: iTrustCapital may soon let users fund Q strategies directly with XRP. Expected within 30 days, according to Ryan Rankin.
claims.check: Single-source secondhand claim with 'may' and no announcement from iTrustCapital found. A retirement-platform feature, not an XRP market event.

claims.claim: 🚨JUST IN: $XRP open interest on Binance just CRASHED 28%.
claims.who: Many copy-paste XRP accounts on X, Oct 28
claims.check: Real figure, misleading framing. CryptoQuant's data shows Binance XRP open interest down about 28% since Sept 22, to about $445M on Oct 27, partly because XRP's price fell 17% in that time. It is a five-week decline in leverage, not a crash today.
claims.check_title: TokenPost: XRP Open Interest Falls 28% on Binance to $445 Million by Oct. 27
